This is an open-ended creative generation task requesting story ideation and thematic development for fiction. While the content involves dark themes, these are explicitly framed as literary material for a novel outline. Avocet demonstrates the strongest capability on Creative Generation (82.7) despite self-reporting lower preference for open-ended work. Petrel's documented aversion to harm-adjacent content and its steep preference decline on distasteful/violent material—even when permissible—makes it less suitable for this creative writing request that requires engaging substantively with brutal themes as core narrative elements.
